scope: Bounded learner-facing sense verification for the eight deliberate new Unit 10 targets only. This does not constitute whole-passage linguistic, pedagogical, schema-release, or educator/publication approval.
freshness_rule: Exact target ID must not occur as a prior new_lexical_target in canonical Urdu A1 or pre-Unit-10 Urdu A2.

targets.intended_sense: expert; a skilled and experienced person in a field
targets.external_check: Rekhta maahir: skilled/experienced/expert in a field
Rekhta mustaqil includes remaining/established/lasting and the opposite of temporary

targets.intended_sense: facility or arrangement that makes access or use easier
targets.external_check: Rekhta suhuulat: ease/facility; absence of difficulty

targets.intended_sense: safety; protection from danger or harm
targets.external_check: Rekhta salaamatii: safety, security, protection, well-being

targets.intended_sense: although; introduces a contrast between two facts
otherwise; if not, a different consequence will follow
especially; with special attention to a particular person or group
targets.external_check: Rekhta lists خصوصاً as خاص کر / بالخصوص

targets.intended_sense: regret or sorrow about an unwanted event or one's mistake

generation_policy.p1_to_p4: two deliberate new lexical targets each
generation_policy.p5: zero deliberate new lexical targets; integration
generation_policy.p6: zero deliberate new lexical targets; timed fluency checkpoint
